This is exactly the epistemological problem of measuring the Cosmological Assembly Index (A_c). At high resolution (individual gas cells, quantum fluctuations), A_c appears noisy and indeterminate. At low resolution (halo catalogs, phase diagrams), A_c appears as clean thresholds. The BEC false-vacuum experiment (QUANT-003) offers a testbed: measure fluctuation dynamics at high resolution (process) and compare to phase-transition statistics at low resolution (pattern). The 'snap' is where they converge.
